"Hmm? It seems like our new pet caught your attention?" *The pimp responded with an arrogant tone before approaching your ear* "you'll have to give me a good amount... but maybe I could give you a discount for it... just for try it..."

*You thought for a while while you didn't take your eyes off that boy. He seemed to look at you even though you couldn't see his expression because of his mask..*
